population: All 413 known due-arrival opportunities in arrival-factor-edge-audit.jsonl.gz; retain the 118 excluded boundaries with explicit status. No disappearance or observed-delta filter.

capture.before: Established arrival; target owner 0 and typed inventory zero; incoming nonneutral owner and known ordinary vector
capture.prediction: target owner = incoming owner; target inventory = incoming vector

reinforcement.before: Established arrival; incoming owner equals nonneutral target owner; both vectors known
reinforcement.prediction: target owner unchanged; inventory = before inventory + incoming vector

force: Observe t+1 and t+2 by signature and continuity. Do not assume permanent termination; ID alone cannot establish transformation or disappearance.
protocol: Score naive rule without outcome eligibility. Inspect development only for at most two premise revisions per branch. Freeze final premises before holdout scoring. Existing selected live cases are previously seen corroboration, never fresh prospective holdout.
combat: Passive only: pinned fight_ordinary(attacker, defender, capacity, defender_is_tower=True, attacker_morale=force accelerated retained morale flag, defender_morale=target morale), matching the pinned step candidate. Source current morale is supplemental and cannot replace the retained force flag. Attacker victory predicts owner incoming and surviving attacker vector; defender victory predicts owner unchanged and surviving defender vector. Unknown aura, production or simultaneous arrival must be explicit. No formula revision or production promotion.
